text.es: ¿Sabés aproximadamente cuántos miligramos de cafeína consumís por día?
text.en: Do you know approximately how many milligrams of caffeine you consume per day?
text.it: Sai approssimativamente quanti milligrammi di caffeina assumi al giorno?

help_text.es: Incluí café, mate, té, bebidas energizantes, preentrenos y suplementos. Si no sabés la cantidad, elegí «No sé». No convertiremos tazas a miligramos sin datos.
help_text.en: Include all sources. Unknown is allowed and blocks dose-dependent assessment.
help_text.it: Includi tutte le fonti. Se non lo sai, indica che non lo sai.

data_quality.validation_notes: Numeric input must be entered by user or established from verified product composition. Unknown cannot be treated as zero.
